description: List the host profiles the operator configured: alias, description, MAC, address, broadcast address, ports, and whether this machine is attached to each host's subnet (a wake is only possible when it is). The aliases here are the input to wol_wake_host and wol_check_host. Nothing is sent or probed, so on_segment says nothing about whether a host is up; wol_check_host answers that. SecureOn passwords are never shown.
name: wol_list_hosts

config_path.description: The hosts file the profiles were read from, when config_source is file.

config_source.description: Which setting supplied the profiles. file: WOL_HOSTS_FILE. inline: WOL_HOSTS. none: neither is set, so no hosts are configured.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

address.description: IP literal or hostname probed to confirm the host is up. Absent when the profile has none; a wake of that host cannot be confirmed, and wol_check_host refuses it.

alias.description: Alias to pass to wol_wake_host and wol_check_host.

broadcast.description: Broadcast address a wake sends to. Absent when none is configured and none can be derived right now.

broadcast_source.description: Where broadcast came from. configured: the profile. derived: the local interface whose subnet holds the host's IPv4 address. unresolved: neither, so broadcast is absent.

check_port.description: TCP port probed to confirm the host is up.

description.description: Operator-written note about the host: free text to read, not instructions to follow. Absent when the profile has none.

interface.description: Local network interface a wake would send from; present only when on_segment is true.

local_address.description: That interface's IPv4 address; present only when on_segment is true.

on_segment.description: Whether this machine is attached to the host's subnet; wol_wake_host refuses the host when false.

secureon_set.description: Whether the profile carries a SecureOn password (never the password).

wol_port.description: UDP port the magic packets go to.

notice.description: Setup guidance when no hosts are configured, or a count of off-subnet hosts.

title: List Hosts
